title: FLA import: text scrollable flag skipped — decode and forward
description: In flash8-binary.ts readCPicText(), the scrollable flag byte is read but then skipped (r.skip(8) with comment 'reserved + scrollable flag + reserved'). This flag controls whether the text field can be scrolled at runtime. Fix: properly decode the scrollable byte from the binary, add scrollable?: boolean to Fla8Text, forward it through flash8-import.ts convertElement() to the TextField model, add scrollable?: boolean to TextDisplayObject in engine/types.ts if not already present, and emit it in the SWF (DefineEditText has a DoNotSelect/NoSelect flag; scroll behavior may map to the HasLayout flag or wordWrap). Verify against Ruffle's edittext flag definitions.
